hypotheses.name: Diffusion uplift under coexpression-degree matched null
hypotheses.method: Recomputed diffusion-vs-baseline AUROC deltas across immune/lung/external_lung (3 seeds, layers 0/3/7/11, source+target disjoint splits) and calibrated with both random-label permutations and coexpression+degree matched label permutations using processed h5ad-derived Pearson coexpression bins.
hypotheses.result_value: +0.00774 mean AUROC delta overall; matched-null Fisher p-values: immune=0.0749, lung=0.1878, external_lung=0.99999
hypotheses.next_action: Test diffusion incremental value after explicit coexpression+degree covariate adjustment rather than raw AUROC delta under matched null.

hypotheses.name: CCA-seeded one-to-one GW correspondence rescue
hypotheses.method: Aligned matched scGPT/Geneformer genes (280/domain) with PCA+CCA seed map, annealed entropic GW, then one-to-one Hungarian projection; evaluated top-1/mutual-top1 and edge-transfer AUROC against random-correspondence nulls and compared to H27 unseeded GW plus CCA-seed baseline.
hypotheses.result_value: mean top-1=0.00833 (combined Fisher p=0.1248), mean transfer AUROC=0.5008 (combined Fisher p=0.4345), mean delta AUC vs H27=-0.0178
hypotheses.next_action: Retire GW-based correspondence mapping as primary path and pivot cross-model mapping to CCA/spectral families unless a materially different supervised-anchor GW variant is introduced.
hypotheses.retirement_reason: Two consecutive GW variants (unseeded H27, seeded+one-to-one H29) failed correspondence/transfer significance despite strong controls.

hypotheses.name: Triangle-thinness hyperbolicity edge screen
hypotheses.method: Computed endpoint-local geodesic triangle-thinness scores on scGPT kNN manifolds across immune/lung/external_lung (seed42, layers 0/3/7/11, source+target disjoint) and calibrated AUROC with degree+distance matched label permutations.
hypotheses.result_value: mean thinness AUROC=0.4657 vs geodesic baseline 0.5508; significant rows 1/24; significant domain-split groups 1/6
hypotheses.next_action: Do not refine this exact thinness formulation; replace with a different topology mechanism (e.g., diffusion-time persistence vineyards) before revisiting hyperbolicity claims.
